format.rule: Every skill writes this one shape. Never record a pass without running the command; then run the plugin's scripts/execution-check.mjs until it exits 0.
format.issue: issues.<ID> = { status, branch, pr, decisions: [DEC-NNN], acceptance: { <criterion>: "<STATE>: <command> -> <result>" } }; in-review and done need at least one EXECUTED line.
format.evidence: Append one entry per command run, in order (the session's changelog): { date: YYYY-MM-DD, state, command, result }.
format.states: EXECUTED (ran it), INSPECTED (read it), NOT_RUN (with why), BLOCKED (with what is needed).
